state.case_summary:
A 36-year-old man presented with:- Several months history of headaches, fevers, nausea, and malaise- Progressed to generalized weakness, weight loss, and altered mental status- Later developed worsening encephalopathy and inability to tolerate oral intake- Subsequently developed chorea involving left upper and lower extremities- Later developed painful vesicular oral and genital lesions with low-grade fever- At rehabilitation, developed severe odynophagia and hypersalivation- Persistently febrile up to 39.3°C despite broad antimicrobial coverage

Initial presentation:- Temperature 38.1°C - Intermittently able to answer questions- Otherwise nonfocal neurologic examination- Later examination showed:  - Lesions on scrotum and penile shaft  - Oral lesions isolated to lips and buccal mucosa  - No other rashes identified  - No intraocular lesions present

Laboratory Tests:- Initial labs showed:  - Leukocytosis (21 × 10³/μL)  - Elevated C-reactive protein: 2.7 mg/L  - Elevated sedimentation rate: 34 mm/h  - Mild iron deficiency anemia  - Normal blood cultures, urinalysis, lactic acid, and immunologic panelCerebrospinal Fluid Analysis:- Lymphocytic pleocytosis with mixed inflammatory cells- Glucose: 43 mg/dL- Protein: 80 mg/dL- RBC: 3 cells/μL- Nucleated cells: 383 cells/μL with 83% lymphocytes- Negative for malignancy and oligoclonal bands- Positive West Nile virus IgG, negative IgM- Negative autoimmune encephalitis panelImaging Studies:- Initial CT head: No pathologic findings- CT abdomen/pelvis: Possible ascending colitis- MRI Brain findings:  Image 1 Title: T2 FLAIR MRI showing mesodiencephalic junction hyperintensities  Image 1 Description: Hyperintensities in thalami, midbrain, and pons    Image 2 Title: T2 FLAIR MRI showing pontine involvement  Image 2 Description: Hyperintensities in left middle cerebellar peduncle, medial left temporal lobe, and cerebral white matter with foci of restricted diffusionOther Tests:- EEG: No epileptiform activity- Laryngoscopy: Lesions isolated to lips and buccal mucosa
